answer: The tide is the filter. Each epoch, 36 basalt gates open in one 20-minute tide window; each challenge seeded by the last block plus the key. Entry locks 80 POA, +40 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,600 POA. Each gate needs a violet seal from a stranger with a three-epoch pass, each sealing at most two. One operator tends at most two gates, so ten fakes need five hands, ten strangers, ten live answers at once. A missed tide burns 25 POA; gates sharing one hand count as one. Gate times are checked against funding roots; a seal sharing the applicant's root is void.
